description: This file contains API client functions for dictionary lookups, including methods for constructing the base URL based on environment variables and fetching word definitions from the dictionary API.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the API base URL based on environment variables or defaults to the public dictionary API.

methods.name: fetchDefinitions(word)
methods.description: Fetches definitions, phonetics, meanings, synonyms, and antonyms for a given word from the configured dictionary API.
